newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco says no plans to declassify shares.
newsitem.headline: Meralco says no plans to declassify shares.

text.p: Power retailer Manila Electric Co has no plans to remove its A and B stocks classification, president Manuel Lopez told reporters on Thursday.
A shares are sold only to Filipinos while B shares are open to Filipino and foreign investors. B shares usually trade higher than A shares due to the wider ownership base.
Foreign investors of Meralco, who hold a combined 20 percent stake in the firm, would be disappointed if they lose the premium on their B shares, Lopez said.
Meralco B shares were hit by a selldown in May due to false rumours that the Securities and Exchange Commission issued new rules allowing foreigners to buy A shares.
SEC chairman Perfecto Yasay had said the SEC cannot force companies to declassify their shares but he welcomed the voluntary declassification by some firms.
